definitions.explanation: Moving or still images, especially in professional or broadcast contexts.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{映像|えいぞう}の{映画|えいが}だ。
examples.english: It's a film with beautiful visuals.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{映像|えいぞう}が{放送|ほうそう}された。
examples.english: Footage of the accident was broadcast.

examples.japanese: {映像|えいぞう}{作品|さくひん}を{制作|せいさく}する。

notes:
COMPOUND: {映|えい} (reflect, project) + {像|ぞう} (image)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{映像|えいぞう}を{見|み}る (to watch footage)
・{映像|えいぞう}{作品|さくひん} (video work, visual production)
・{映像|えいぞう}{制作|せいさく} (video production)
・{映像|えいぞう}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (video technology)
・{映像|えいぞう}{編集|へんしゅう} (video editing)
・{生|なま}{映像|えいぞう} (live footage)

CONTRAST:
・{映像|えいぞう} - formal, professional contexts (TV, film)
・{動画|どうが} - casual, online videos
・ビデオ - often refers to physical media

[Register: Neutral/Formal]
